description:
Build the engine's own gate findings from closed enums, while external checker output stays open on the wire.

## Background

Built-in findings spell severity, disposition and origin as literals at `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:622-629`, `:662-664`, `:1123-1125` and `:1148-1150`, and the engine branches on `disposition == Some("blocking")` (`:1188`). On the wire, `GateFinding` severity, disposition and origin are checker-defined open strings (`domain/gate_findings.rs:46-66`), because external checkers emit labels such as `medium`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `domain/gate_findings.rs` declares closed enums for built-in severity, disposition and origin through the macro.
- [hard] REQ-02: The four built-in sites build findings through a typed constructor, and the engine's blocking check compares the enum.
- [hard] REQ-03: Finding wire fields stay strings, and a finding with a checker-defined label still loads.
title: Built-in gate findings use closed severity and disposition enums
